paras: Leviton's gecko (Altiphylax levitoni) is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Asia.
The specific name, levitoni, is in honor of American herpetologist Alan E. Leviton (born 1930).
A. levitoni is found in northeastern Afghanistan.

The preferred natural habitat of A. levitoni is rocky areas of shrubland and forest, at altitudes of 1,800–2,300 m (5,900–7,500 ft), but it has also been found on buildings and rock walls in villages.
